A TOG (Thermal Overall Grade) rating is a unit of heat measurement. It measures insulation or amount of warmth a fabric provides. A TOG rating tells you how warm the item will keep your baby.

Our table is a guideline for choosing the appropriate wearable blanket for your baby, depending on the temperature of the baby's nursery and weight of the bag.
